title: Loan chukaya, papers nahi mile? Roz ₹5,000.
hooks: Loan chukaya, papers abhi tak nahi mile? Roz ₹5,000 bante hain.
Bank ne property papers rok liye? Din ke ₹5,000 bante hain.
Home loan khatam, par bank papers nahi de raha? RBI ka niyam jaano.
hook_why: Opens with the ₹5,000 number and the viewer's pain point in conversational Hindi — matches the 'Bank pays you' hook pattern that top rival reels use. No intro, immediate stakes.
metaphor: A locked steel briefcase (property papers) with a digital counter ticking ₹5,000/day on its face — the bank holds the briefcase, the counter is the RBI penalty clock.

caption:
Loan chukaya, papers abhi tak nahi mile? Bank ko roz ₹5,000 dene padenge 💸
RBI ka niyam: poora loan chukane ke 30 din mein original papers wapas. Der hui toh har din ₹5,000.
Papers kho gaye? Bank ko 30 din aur, phir wahi ₹5,000 roz.
Pehle bank ko likh ke complaint, 30 din mein jawab nahi toh cms.rbi.org.in
Source: RBI circular, 13 Sep 2023 (laagu 1 Dec 2023)
Save karo, kaam aayega 📌

claims.claim: RBI mandates return of property documents within 30 days of loan closure
claims.basis: RBI circular dated 1 December 2023 on 'Return of Original Movable/Immovable Property Documents'

claims.claim: Penalty of ₹5,000 per day applies after 30 days of delay
Rule applies to all secured loans: home loan, loan against property, car loan, gold loan
claims.basis: RBI circular covers all REs (banks, NBFCs, HFCs, etc.) for secured loans

claims.claim: All regulated entities covered: scheduled commercial banks, NBFCs, HFCs, RRBs, cooperative banks, ARCs
If documents lost, bank gets additional 30 days (total 60) to provide certified copies, then ₹5,000/day penalty applies
claims.basis: RBI circular provision for lost documents

claims.claim: Complaint process: first write to bank, wait 30 days, then escalate to RBI CMS portal
claims.basis: Standard RBI grievance redressal mechanism per RBI guidelines

kiro_checked: 19 Nov: checked by hand against RBI 13 Sep 2023 circular (ET, Indian Express, Mint): 30 days, ₹5,000/day, lost papers +30 days, all REs; gold loan removed
